import sys, json
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd


def num(x, nd=2):
    return round(float(x), nd)


def main():
    df = pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1])
    facts = []

    def add(entity, metric, period, value, formula):
        if value is None or (isinstance(value, float) and not np.isfinite(value)):
            return
        facts.append({
            "entity": str(entity),
            "metric": metric,
            "period": period,
            "value": float(value),
            "formula": formula,
        })

    for c in ["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW", "Revenue_LY", "Units_TW", "Units_LW",
              "Orders_TW", "Orders_LW", "WoW_Pct", "YoY_Pct", "Share_Pct", "Rank"]:
        if c in df.columns:
            df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors="coerce")

    tw = df["Revenue_TW"].sum(skipna=True)
    lw = df["Revenue_LW"].sum(skipna=True)
    ly = df["Revenue_LY"].sum(skipna=True)

    # ---- Totals ----
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "TW", num(tw), "sum(Revenue_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LW", num(lw), "sum(Revenue_LW)")
    add("TOTAL", "revenue", "LY", num(ly), "sum(Revenue_LY)")
    if lw > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "WoW", num((tw - lw) / lw * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LW)) / sum(Revenue_LW) * 100")
    if ly > 0:
        add("TOTAL", "revenue", "YoY", num((tw - ly) / ly * 100, 1),
            "(sum(Revenue_TW) - sum(Revenue_LY)) / sum(Revenue_LY) * 100")
    add("TOTAL", "units", "TW", num(df["Units_TW"].sum(skipna=True), 0), "sum(Units_TW)")
    add("TOTAL", "orders", "TW", num(df["Orders_TW"].sum(skipna=True), 0), "sum(Orders_TW)")

    # ---- Largest entities this week ----
    top = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW"]).sort_values("Revenue_TW", ascending=False).head(5)
    for _, r in top.iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "TW", num(r["Revenue_TW"]), "Revenue_TW for the entity")
    if len(top):
        lead = top.iloc[0]
        sh = lead["Share_Pct"] if pd.notna(lead.get("Share_Pct")) else (
            lead["Revenue_TW"] / tw * 100 if tw else np.nan)
        add(lead["Entity"], "share", "TW", num(sh, 1), "Revenue_TW / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")
        add(lead["Entity"], "rank", "TW", num(lead["Rank"], 0), "rank by Revenue_TW (1 = highest)")

    # Top-5 concentration
    if tw > 0 and len(top):
        add("TOTAL", "share", "TW", num(top["Revenue_TW"].sum() / tw * 100, 1),
            "sum(top 5 Revenue_TW) / sum(Revenue_TW) * 100")

    # ---- WoW movers by absolute revenue change ----
    d = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LW"]).copy()
    d["abs_wow"] = d["Revenue_TW"] - d["Revenue_LW"]
    for _, r in d.sort_values("abs_wow", ascending=False).head(3).iterrows():
        if r["abs_wow"] > 0:
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(r["abs_wow"]), "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")
    for _, r in d.sort_values("abs_wow").head(3).iterrows():
        if r["abs_wow"] < 0:
            add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(r["abs_wow"]), "Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW")

    # ---- WoW percent movers (material base only) ----
    p = d[d["Revenue_LW"] > 0].copy()
    p = p[p["Revenue_TW"] >= p["Revenue_TW"].median()]
    for _, r in p.sort_values("WoW_Pct", ascending=False).head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(r["WoW_Pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")
    for _, r in p.sort_values("WoW_Pct").head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "WoW", num(r["WoW_Pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LW) / Revenue_LW * 100")

    # ---- YoY movers ----
    y = df.dropna(subset=["Revenue_TW", "Revenue_LY"])
    y = y[y["Revenue_LY"] > 0].copy()
    y["yoy_pct"] = y["YoY_Pct"].fillna((y["Revenue_TW"] - y["Revenue_LY"]) / y["Revenue_LY"] * 100)
    for _, r in y.sort_values("yoy_pct", ascending=False).head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", num(r["yoy_pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")
    for _, r in y.sort_values("yoy_pct").head(2).iterrows():
        add(r["Entity"], "revenue", "YoY", num(r["yoy_pct"], 1),
            "(Revenue_TW - Revenue_LY) / Revenue_LY * 100")

    # ---- Volume leaders ----
    u = df.dropna(subset=["Units_TW"]).sort_values("Units_TW", ascending=False)
    if len(u):
        add(u.iloc[0]["Entity"], "units", "TW", num(u.iloc[0]["Units_TW"], 0), "max(Units_TW)")
    o = df.dropna(subset=["Orders_TW"]).sort_values("Orders_TW", ascending=False)
    if len(o):
        add(o.iloc[0]["Entity"], "orders", "TW", num(o.iloc[0]["Orders_TW"], 0), "max(Orders_TW)")

    print(json.dumps(facts[:25]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
